description: This file implements notification handling for web configuration, including thread management, message queue, and notification payload creation and sending.

methods.name: get_global_notify_threadid
methods.description: Returns the thread ID of the notification thread.

methods.name: get_global_notify_con
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the notification condition variable.

methods.name: get_global_notify_mut
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the notification mutex.

methods.name: initWebConfigNotifyTask
methods.description: Creates and starts the notification processing thread.

methods.name: addWebConfgNotifyMsg
methods.description: Adds a notification message to the queue for processing.

methods.name: free_notify_params_struct
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a notify_params_t structure.

methods.name: getStatusErrorCodeAndMessage
methods.description: Maps error status codes to string messages and numeric codes.
